mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs (company_id, title, description, requirements, contact_name, contact_phone, location, province, city, district, address, latitude, longitude, category_id, rate_type, rate_amount, status, published_at, headcount, deadline, image_url, auto_approve, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{location}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{categoryId}, #{rateType}, #{rateAmount}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, #{headcount}, #{deadline}, #{imageUrl}, #{autoApprove}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT id, company_id, title, description, requirements, contact_name, contact_phone, location, province, city, district, address, latitude, longitude, category_id, rate_type, rate_amount, status, published_at, headcount, accepted_count, deadline, created_at, updated_at, close_reason, auto_approve, image_url, task_type, pricing_mode, price_per_unit, total_items, external_task_id, external_system_type, auto_settle FROM jobs
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, requirements = #{requirements}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, location = #{location}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, category_id = #{categoryId}, rate_type = #{rateType}, rate_amount = #{rateAmount}, status = #{status}, headcount = #{headcount}, deadline = #{deadline}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, auto_approve = #{autoApprove} WHERE id = #{id}
